meta.title: Model context budget
meta.description: A left-sidebar page for the current session provider's model budgets. Separates catalog maxTokens from default request output reservation O, uses the selected Agent preset's official compaction policy to preview the inverse window, threshold and verbatim-tail budget, and writes only the target model contextWindow through official settings after explicit user confirmation with readback. Never compacts or changes policy. Session request overrides can change the actual threshold. Unknown policy, unsupported write paths and invalid budgets cannot be saved.

ui.title: Model context budget
ui.subtitle: Adjust the window, not compaction
ui.noSession: Open a session, then return to this page from the sidebar.
ui.readOnly: Read-only: this model's write path or provider rules are not verified.
ui.autoOff: Official policy has auto=false. Budgets below do not mean automatic compaction is enabled. This plugin does not change the switch.
ui.policyUnknown: Official compaction semantics are unavailable. Saving is disabled.
ui.scope: Only the current session provider is shown. Writes affect future requests using this model in the current profile, not just this session.
ui.override: Thresholds use the model's default request output reservation. Session maxTokens overrides, in-flight requests and route changes can produce a different actual threshold.
ui.capabilityHelp: Catalog maxTokens is output capability, not request reservation. O comes only from the official adapter's defaultMaxTokens; the official rule uses O=0 when no request cap is declared.
ui.unavailable: Catalog capability not exposed by the official API
ui.targetHelp: Enter a positive integer token count, such as 640000. Budgets are tokens, not characters or message counts.
ui.invalidTarget: T must be a positive safe integer, without decimals or K/M suffixes.
ui.retentionHelp: This is the official token budget for retaining recent verbatim content, not a guaranteed number of messages. Fixed retainTokens does not grow with W.
ui.verified: Verified by substitution: the new threshold equals T.
ui.capacityWarning: The calculated window exceeds the current declaration. The formula does not verify endpoint capacity. Confirm that the model supports this window before saving, or later requests may fail.
ui.acknowledge: I have checked this preview and confirm saving only this model's contextWindow to the current profile, preserving every other setting and the official compaction policy.
ui.saved: Written through the official service and confirmed by readback.
ui.unchangedOthers: Only the target contextWindow changes. maxTokens, provider parameters, other models and compaction policy stay unchanged.
ui.empty: No available configured models for the selected provider.
